pr_title: pane: Improve close active item to better handle pinned tabs
pr_body:
Closes #22247

This PR does following:

- [x]  Do not close pinned tab on keyboard shortcuts like `ctrl+w` or `alt+f4`
- [x] Close pinned tab on context menu action, menu bar action, or vim bang
- [x] While closing pinned tab via shortcut (where it won't close), instead activate any other non-pinned tab in same pane
- [x] Else, if any other pane contains non-pinned tab, activate that
- [x] Tests

This PR also fixes a bug where the `close_pinned` boolean in the keymap wasn’t being respected. The issue was in deserialization from JSON to the Rust struct. The struct had `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` annotated on it, which means serialize keys to camelCase, and deserialize keys **only** from camelCase. Because of this, `close_pinned` wasn’t being parsed correctly. I have updated the key to camelCase now, which is also pattern at lot of places. We should make this consistent in long run.

Preview:

This mimics the behavior in VSCode.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/67d18971-e13c-411b-bb83-dd994b6ebcd9


Release Notes:

- Pinned tab now stay open when using close shortcuts, auto focuses to any other non-pinned tab instead.
